Terms.Name: Combine Overwatch
Terms.Description: The Combine's joint humanoid military and police forces on Earth

Terms.Name: Airwatch
Terms.Description: An aerial support and surveillance branch

Terms.Name: Civil Protection
Terms.Description: A conscripted human law enforcement force

Terms.Name: Transhuman forces
Terms.Description: A military ground force of modified human soldiers

Terms.Name: Synths
Terms.Description: A conglomerate of modified species from various other worlds

Terms.Name: Civic populace
Terms.Description: All humans designated as citizens within a Combine-controlled city

Terms.Name: Industrial Workforce
Terms.Description: The Combine's humanoid civilian labor force

Terms.Name: Engineer Core
Terms.Description: A non-combatant technician unit that participates in the maintenance or construction of Combine technology and other infrastructure

Terms.Name: Infestation Control
Terms.Description: A non-combatant HAZMAT service that specializes in cleaning up areas that have been infested with alien flora and fauna from Xen

Terms.Name: Medical Workforce
Terms.Description: A volunteer-sanctioned medical group organized by civilians

Terms.Name: Security Council
Terms.Description: The puppet civilian body utilized to oversee minor civic affairs and spread Combine-affiliated propaganda
